notes: Langland, Fergus, Lingo and Apjones are printed bare ('LANGLAND', 'FERGUS', 'LINGO', 'APJONES'); written with Street. Chase is labelled 'CHASE AV. (60' WIDE)' but drawn only ~240 px (about 40 ft) between faces (north ~5620, south ~5858 at the west, both edging north toward the east); centres taken between the drawn faces. Pullan's north face leaves the top of the paper at x~2200; east of that the Pullan centre is set 186 px (60 ft) north of the south face, so Langland/Pullan (Langland's pipe runs on north toward sheet 635; key map shows Langland continuing) depends on that offset. Williamson Place and Fergus run off the top of the paper before reaching Pullan (their Pullan junctions are on sheet 635). Lingo (printed 50'): only its north face is on the paper (~7486 at the west, ~7471 at Fergus; paper edge ~7720). Every other pipe on this sheet runs within ~10 px of its street centre, and the Lingo pipe runs 115-128 px south of the north face, so Lingo, like Chase, is drawn only ~40 ft wide; the Lingo points are put on the pipe line (y 7613 at x 1143 falling to 7588 at Fergus). If Lingo were really drawn 50 ft wide they would sit ~30 px too far north. Langland is a little narrower south of Chase (west face moves ~30 px east); Fergus jogs ~25 px west south of Chase. Both Chase crossings are put at the middle of the four block corners. Lingo ends at Fergus (Fergus' east face runs on past Lingo to the paper edge). Ingot Alley (12', named) runs SSE from the south side of Chase (opposite the 632-side block west of Brookside) to Lingo; south of Lingo is off the paper, so the T there is not certain. Alleys (all unnamed): (1) 12' N-S alley in the Langland-Williamson block from Pullan's south face (Pullan centre is off the paper) south to (2) the 12' E-W alley Langland-Williamson; (3) 12' N-S alley in the Williamson-Fergus block from the top paper edge (continues north toward Pullan off the paper) south to (4) the 12' E-W alley Williamson-Fergus; (5-7) a 16' E-W alley south of Chase running from x~583 (lines stop at the '623' label, so it probably continues west onto sheet 623) across Ingot Alley and Langland to Fergus; (8) 12' N-S alley from that alley south to Lingo in the Ingot-Langland block; (9) 12' N-S alley from Chase to Lingo just east of the Langland lots, crossing the 16' alley; (10) 12' N-S alley from the 16' alley south to Lingo near Fergus. Apjones has no printed width (drawn ~370 px).
